entities.summary:
Valentinas Mikelėnas is a Lithuanian lawyer, former Justice of the Supreme Court of Lithuania, and one of the most prominent Lithuanian civil law scholars at Vilnius University. Mikelėnas was the head of the Drafting Group of the Civil Code of Lithuania in 1991. He is also one of the founding members of the European Law Institute, a non-profit organisation that conducts research, makes recommendations and provides practical guidance in the field of European legal development.

He is a partner in the law firm Ellex Valiunas. Valentinas Mikelėnas was a legal figures from Lithuanian Soviet Socialist Republic (b. 1958-04-06, Lithuanian Soviet Socialist Republic). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
